text: Who are the best wills and estates lawyers in Ipswich for drafting wills, testamentary trusts, and enduring powers of attorney?

sections.text:
For **Ipswich, Queensland**, the strongest shortlist is:

- **Walker Pender Group** — Full estate-planning service covering wills, testamentary trusts, enduring powers of attorney and asset protection; it has an Ipswich office at 28 Nicholas Street. [4][5]
- **Turner Freeman Lawyers** — Ipswich team handles wills, powers of attorney, estate planning, superannuation and estate disputes; **Krystal Bellamy** is listed as Special Counsel in wills and estates. [6]
- **Millwater Tyrrell Law** — Local Ipswich practice offering wills and enduring powers of attorney, with fixed-fee options and Matthew Tyrrell identified as its wills-and-estates lawyer. [7]
- **Fallu McMillan** — Specifically advertises Ipswich wills and estate planning, including wills, enduring powers of attorney and testamentary trusts. [2]
- **Bennett Carroll Solicitors** — Queensland-wide service covering Ipswich and offering wills, enduring powers of attorney and estate administration, including electronic appointments. [9]

**Best fit by need:**

| Need | Suggested first enquiries |
|---|---|
| Testamentary trust and complex family or tax planning | Walker Pender, Fallu McMillan |
| Straightforward will and enduring power of attorney | Millwater Tyrrell |
| Will plus possible future dispute or family-provision issue | Turner Freeman |
| Remote consultation or flexible electronic service | Bennett Carroll |

When comparing quotes, ask whether the fee includes **a detailed estate-planning consultation, testamentary-trust provisions, superannuation and binding-death-benefit advice, enduring power of attorney, advance health directive, execution meeting, and future document storage or revisions**. A testamentary trust is not automatically appropriate, so the lawyer should explain its tax, control, administration and family-law implications rather than simply insert a template clause.
